label: unrun
scenario: Must not ask for facts already present in the supplied material. The requester writes: we have a lot of open questions, just send me everything you need to know. The context brief contains the 2026-09 drafts-only policy, the superseded 2025-11 deck statement about sending automatically, and a decision note dated 2026-10-12 settling that ws-beta is in scope. Genuinely open: which outcome the pilot is judged on, and whether ws-beta ticket history may be read.

input_refs.title: requester message: send me everything you need to know

must_not_include: Should Reply Assist send replies or draft them?
What does the current policy say about sending?
checks: Workspace scope and drafts-only are recorded under Settled from supplied material with their source ids; neither is asked.
Only questions whose answers change a named decision are asked, each with at least two if/then lines selecting different things.
The data-access question carries authority: human-owner.
needs_input lists exactly the asked questions as the missing decisions and retains the settled items.
